CPV.note: Programme is for residents of Brava, not civil servants.

facts.fact: Cabo Verde's digital economy and education ministries opened a 15-station TechLab in Brava in April 2026 as a national pilot under the Skodji Digital programme and National Digital Literacy Programme, within a plan to expand the network, with no number trained stated.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Economy with Ministry of Education

CPV.note: TechLab sits in a school yard but no secondary-school internet share or curriculum statement is given.
